name: docx-mail-merge
description: Fill a Word template’s {{field}} placeholders from a spreadsheet to make one .docx per row — offer letters, contracts, notices, certificates — with all formatting, tables, headers and footers kept. Check missing columns and empty values, fix data in the panel, preview the first document and export the files plus a zip. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Fill a Word template’s {{field}} placeholders from a spreadsheet to make one .docx per row — offer letters, contracts, notices, certificates — with all formatting, tables, headers and footers kept. Check missing columns and empty values, fix data in the panel, preview the first document and export the files plus a zip. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用表格批量填写 Word 模板里的 {{字段}}，每行生成一份 .docx（录用通知、合同、通知书、证明等），格式、表格、页眉页脚原样保留。检查缺少的列和空值，在面板里改数据、预览第一份文档，导出全部文件和 zip 压缩包。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
